name: Grand Canyon
about: Year-round but extreme; spring and fall are ideal for hiking with mild rim temps, summer inner-canyon heat is dangerous, the North Rim closes in winter.
overview: One of the most recognizable natural landmarks on Earth, a mile-deep gorge carved by the Colorado River.
costOverview: In-park food costs more than a normal small town would charge — a mule ride below the rim is the one real splurge activity most people consider.

costItems.label: Motorized rafting trip, 7 days, full canyon
